summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026 disclosing an at-the-market sales agreement with R.F. Lafferty Co., Inc. as agent or principal for up to 30,000,000 shares of Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (CHAD). Sales occur under an effective Form S-3 shelf (No. 333-295142) via Rule 415 at-the-market methods. The company has no obligation to sell; either party may terminate on ten days' notice. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; terms such as price per share or premium are unstated.
